incidents.method: September 2026: value-weighted (pro-rata) trace forward from 6 outputs paid by federation spends (4,011.04022820 BTC: the unexplained payouts and the payout made before its peg-out) through 203,268 Bitcoin transactions from 964,990 to 974,307, every satoshi accounted for (difference 0.001 sats): returned to the federation program 3,401.87272866 BTC (magnitude), unspent at the horizon 605.37559700, into other custody outputs 3.02109283, spent after the horizon 0.44534746, in branches below 1,000 sats 0.32430061, fees 0.00116164. The share of a payment attributed to a seed is a modelling choice, not a chain fact. txids = the payments back into the program. incidents.method: custody_outputs / reserve_by_block (bdl-071, corrected by bdl-098): 1,562 outputs of the change script a9148ed14f3b870f8d9012c423ec7a76148ba84f650587 (CSV 2,016) of 0.001 BTC or more became spendable by the 2-of-3 emergency keys, 13,344.28788880 BTC counted once each; peak = all custody the emergency keys could spend after block 634,326 (40.3% of the reserve; magnitude_pct is of L-BTC outstanding). Peak outputs: 870.05719008 BTC spendable in blocks 634,327 to 634,328 (54.3 minutes of header time from 2020-06-12 04:52 UTC); 870.05710308 BTC spendable in blocks 636,345 to 636,346 (40.5 minutes of header time from 2020-06-25 23:48 UTC). After the run, 69 smaller change-script outputs (largest 45,619 sats) still became spendable, the last spent at 765,952. Cause, from the operator's own statement (Adam Back, Blockstream, 'Patching the Liquid Timelock Issue', 2020-06-28, updated 2020-07-03): 'Due to this bug, some timelocks are occasionally being refreshed shortly after expiry, instead of before expiry as designed.' milestones.label: First-ever 2-of-3 emergency spend
milestones.detail: 35 unclaimed peg-in UTXOs (aged 14,772-29,142 blocks vs. 4,032-block CSV) swept via 2-of-3 emergency path to one P2WPKH output.

milestones.label: Liquid block production halts (79.2 hours)
milestones.detail: Last canonical Liquid block before a 79.2-hour halt (block 4,050,335). Reserve before outflow: 4,230.62 BTC vs. 4,205.02 L-BTC (100.61%).

milestones.label: Primary unexplained outflow (11-of-15 normal path)
milestones.detail: 83 federation inputs (4,019.44 BTC) signed via 11-of-15 path paid 3,996.02 + 3.996 + 2.651 BTC to three addresses with no Liquid peg-out request.

milestones.label: Second unexplained outflow & backing trough (5.30%)
milestones.detail: Additional 4.14 BTC paid to an unmatched address; followed by 1.02 BTC at block 965,804 (paid 79.5h before its L2 peg-out). Reserve bottomed at 222.79 BTC vs. 4,205.02 L-BTC (-3,982.22 BTC).

milestones.label: 3,400 BTC returned to federation custody
milestones.detail: 99.94% value-traced to the 3,996.02 BTC outflow; 598.50 BTC remained at the same P2WPKH address unmoved through cutoff. Reserve shortfall narrowed to ~582 BTC.

milestones.label: Liquid restarts + 4 BTC returned
milestones.detail: Liquid resumes after 79.2 hours; 4.0 BTC deposited to federation program (99.93% traced to smaller Sep 6 outflows). Peg-out payouts remain halted.

milestones.label: Fresh external restoration inflows (+602.53 BTC)
milestones.detail: 2.53 BTC (Oct 27) + 50 BTC (Oct 28) + 300 BTC & 250 BTC (Nov 2, blocks 974,299 & 974,307) from unrelated wallets restored 1:1 backing after 57.32 days below full backing.

milestones.label: Direct federation peg-out payouts resume (after 59-day halt)
milestones.detail: First federation Bitcoin peg-out payout since Sep 6 (59 days without payout; 53.9 days wait for the pending Sep 11 request). No custody key rotation occurred.
